# Shares bought in a single-currency book. No foreign currency anywhere.
#
# A share is not foreign currency: it is counted in units, priced rather than
# converted, and a book holding it has no FX question to answer. Testing only
# "not the book's currency" swept these in — the purchase grew a cost-basis
# KVP, `fx-balances` listed it as `50 CAD/USTECH`, and correcting the share
# count with `--strategy update` was refused as touching a cost basis.
#
# What this fixture produces: `fx-balances` finds no cost bases at all, and
# the transaction stays editable.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_securities_are_not_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 commodity USTECH
	mnemonic: "USTECH"
	fullname: "US Tech Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 open Assets:Investments
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Investments:USTECH
	type: Stock
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USTECH"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 10 units at 50.00"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Investments:USTECH 10 USTECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USTECH"
		share_price: "50"
		value: "500.00"
	Assets:Bank -500.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-500.00"
